name: stigmergy
definition: Coordinate indirectly by writing signals into a shared environment that later agents read.

name: quorum
definition: Commit after distributed support crosses a threshold.

name: reinforcement
definition: Increase future selection probability for locally successful paths.

name: decay
definition: Reduce influence of stale state over time.

name: phase_transition
definition: Switch the whole operating policy when a local/system variable crosses a regime boundary.

name: ephemeral_lifecycle
definition: Use deliberately short-lived agents whose persistence exists in artifacts or successors.

name: metamorphosis
definition: Replace an actor's role/tooling/state model between lifecycle stages rather than incrementally adapting one persistent form.

name: successor_reconfiguration
definition: Choose the architecture of a successor based on current environmental pressure.

name: environment_shaping
definition: Modify the environment so future tasks or agents encounter a more favorable structure.

name: predictive_interception
definition: Act toward a predicted future state rather than the target's current state.

name: event_trigger
definition: Remain low-cost until evidence crosses an action trigger.

name: leaderless_consensus
definition: Reach a group allocation/choice without a distinguished supervisor.

name: capacity_aware_aggregation
definition: Let group occupancy react to the capacity of candidate resources.

name: niche_specialization
definition: Reuse a stable kernel while adapting interfaces/tools to different ecological niches.

name: local_signal
definition: Use only local observations as the primary control input.

name: distributed_exploration
definition: Explore multiple alternatives concurrently using multiple weakly coupled agents.

name: role_separation
definition: Separate incompatible objectives/tools/permissions into distinct lifecycle or functional roles.

name: environmental_memory
definition: Persist coordination state in shared artifacts/environment rather than in one agent identity.
